svg.title: Shelters in fine ink
svg.desc: Winter and summer shelters and a drying house, traced from historical drawings and arranged on a warm botanical border.
svg.metadata: Drawing source: Shanawdithit, Sketch VI and VII, reproduced in James P. Howley, The Beothucks, 1915. Reference reproduction: Heritage Newfoundland and Labrador, https://heritagenl.ca/wp-content/uploads/2024/03/Shanawdithit.pdf, figure 2. Original drawing is public domain. Layout, vector tracing and botanical border adapted for this page.
